# Lupa ID

> Lupa ID is the identity and authentication hub for the Lupa ecosystem. Register and verify once, then manage every Lupa project with a single secure master account.

App URL: https://lupa-id.vercel.app/
API base: https://account-server-nine.vercel.app/api/auth

## What is Lupa ID?

- Lupa ID is a centralized identity and authentication platform (single sign-on style) for the Lupa ecosystem.
- One master account is shared across every Lupa project.
- Accounts are email-verified and password-protected.
- Users can sign in by username or email, or via Google OAuth.
- JWT tokens are used for authentication (30-day expiry).

## Key features

- **Registration**: create an account with a username, email, and password (minimum 8 characters; must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character; username is alphanumeric with `_` and `-`, minimum 5 characters).
- **Email verification**: 6-digit OTP code sent to the user's email, with a resend option.
- **Login**: username or email + password, or "Sign in with Google".
- **Account dashboard**: view username and email.
- **Settings**: change username or email, change password (requires current password), switch between light and dark theme, delete account (requires password and typing CONFIRM), and log out.
- **Password reset**: forgotten-password flow with an emailed code.

## API reference (auth)

Base URL: `https://account-server-nine.vercel.app/api/auth`

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | /register | Register with username + email + password |
| POST | /verify | Verify email with 6-digit OTP code |
| POST | /login | Login with identifier (username or email) + password; returns JWT |
| GET | /google | Initiate Google OAuth (returns redirect URL) |
| GET/POST | /google/callback | Google OAuth callback |
| GET | /fetch | Fetch account info by JWT token |
| POST | /change | Change username, email, or password |
| POST | /verifypassword | Verify password before account deletion |
| POST | /delete | Delete account (requires password + CONFIRM) |
| POST | /resetpassword | Reset password via emailed code |
